Bless.paragraph: You bless up to three creatures, steadying their attacks and saves.

facts: Up to three creatures within range
Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, it adds 1d4 to the roll
+1 creature for each spell slot level above 1

Cure Wounds.paragraph: A creature you touch regains Hit Points.

facts: +2d8 for each spell slot level above 1

Fire Bolt.paragraph: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or an object.

facts: A creature or an object within range
A flammable object hit by this spell starts burning if it isn't being worn or carried

Fireball.paragraph: A bright streak flashes from you to a point you choose within range and blossoms into a fiery explosion.

facts: Dexterity, made by each creature in the area
Flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried start burning
+1d6 for each spell slot level above 3

Hold Person.paragraph: You paralyze a Humanoid you can see.

facts: A Humanoid you can see within range
The target has the Paralyzed condition for the duration
At the end of each of its turns; on a success, the spell ends on the target
+1 Humanoid for each spell slot level above 2

Shield.paragraph: An imperceptible barrier of magical force protects you.

facts: You are hit by an attack roll or targeted by the Magic Missile spell
+5 until the start of your next turn, including against the triggering attack
You take no damage from it until the start of your next turn
